title: Explainable Data Poison Attacks on Human Emotion Evaluation Systems based on EEG Signals
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating human emotions using EEG signals for industrial insider threat detection and risk assessment. While it deals with human emotions, its scope is technical (data poisoning attacks, ML model performance, XAI for interpretability) and applied to cybersecurity/risk, rather than a philosophical or ethical evaluation of emotions, morals, or faith itself. The labels used (High-Risk, Medium-Risk, Normal, Low-Risk) pertain to threat levels, not ethical judgments.
